results.question: 各门店销售额排名
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 华东区近30天销售额最高的门店是哪个
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.region='华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 各区域销售额占比
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER (),0), 2) as sales_pct FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER (),0))::numeric, 2) as sales_pct FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 分析华东区最近销售情况
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.manager, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region='华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.manager ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(o.amount) as sales FROM orders o JOIN store s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华东' AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY date

results.question: 对比华东和华北两个区域的销售表现
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0),2) as refund_rate FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY refund_rate DESC

results.question: 分析各区域销售额的同比变化
sqls: SELECT MIN(DATE(create_time)) AS min_date, MAX(DATE(create_time)) AS max_date, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

SELECT s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) AS year, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders
FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time)
ORDER BY s.region, year

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT s.region,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) AS year,
         COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales
  FROM store s
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time)
)
SELECT y2026.region,
       COALESCE(y2025.sales,0) AS sales_2025,
       COALESCE(y2026.sales,0) AS sales_2026,
       COALESCE(y2026.sales,0) - COALESCE(y2025.sales,0) AS change_amount,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(y2025.sales,0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(y2026.sales,0) - COALESCE(y2025.sales,0)) * 100.0 / COALESCE(y2025.sales,0), 2)
       END AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM yearly y2026
LEFT JOIN yearly y2025 ON y2026.region = y2025.region AND y2025.year = 2025
WHERE y2026.year = 2026
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
